summary: RUNDA 1.3 hardening verified. Backend: 9/10 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_runda13_backend.py — A1 files+orphan-410, A2 partial project update (vat/dni/tryb preserved), B3 admin reset returns 16-char pw with must_change_password=True, E1b role guards (contractor→403 on /reports & /extra-hours, /register-push→401 without token), C4 malformed login returns 422 list-detail shape, B5 register rate limit returns 429 on 4th/h/IP — ALL PASS. ONE CRITICAL FAILURE: B5 LOGIN LOCKOUT IS NOT IMPLEMENTED — 6 consecutive wrong-password logins against a TEST user returned [401,401,401,401,401,401] and never 423 (no lockout counter, no lockout field, no lockout code path in server.py). Frontend: FRONTEND-1 forced /change-password redirect works (admin with must_change_password=True is force-navigated), FRONTEND-2 profile has 'Zmień hasło' row (testID=profile-change-password) and NO PIN/biometria mention, FRONTEND-3 Edit User modal shows 'Zresetuj hasło' entry (button text present but MISSING data-testid=user-reset-pw), FRONTEND-7 login with malformed email + short password shows readable Polish/English 422 message ('email: value is not a valid email address...') — no '[object Object]'. FRONTEND 4/5/6 (element→drawing H7, report edit H6.2, dashboard tiles) NOT executed due to context/time budget — recommend main-agent self-verify or dedicated follow-up test iteration. Admin must_change_password restored to True at end of run; TEST_ users archived.

critical.issue: B5 login lockout NOT IMPLEMENTED. Spec: after 5 failed logins → 15-min lock returning HTTP 423. Actual: server.py:539-549 has NO failed-attempt counter, NO users.locked_until field, NO 423 code path. Grep '(lockout|423|failed_login|locked_until)' returns 0 hits in server.py. Test test_login_lockout_after_5_failed_attempts records statuses=[401,401,401,401,401,401] — never 423. This means the owner's account cannot actually be protected against brute-force in prod. Also means the docs/comments in test_credentials.md warning 'do not attempt failed logins on admin' currently describe intended behavior only, not actual behavior.

minor.issue: Rate-limit is stored ONLY in in-memory dict _register_hits (server.py:506) — resets on every backend restart / worker rotation and is not shared across replicas. Adequate for MVP anti-spam but not tamper-proof.
Carried over from iter11: archived user login returns 403 instead of 401 — still un-addressed.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Zresetuj hasło' pressable is missing data-testid=user-reset-pw. Currently only the surrounding text 'Zresetuj hasło' is findable; the underlying pressable/action has no testID, blocking robust E2E automation of the B3 password-reset modal flow.
Row 'Edytuj' and 'Usuń' buttons have no data-testid (e.g. user-edit-{id}, user-delete-{id}). We had to fall back to text-based selection which is fragile.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still warns '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — carried over from iter11. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow (RN 0.76+).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: NO login-lockout code path exists. B5 was implemented for registration (in-memory 3/h/IP) but not for authentication. Missing: (1) increment failed_login_attempts on invalid pw, (2) set locked_until = now+15min at 5th failure, (3) short-circuit login with 423 when locked_until > now, (4) reset counter on success. Add to server.py:540-549 login flow.

server.py:1571 upload_file — A1 storage_put fallback: raises 503 correctly on transient errors; returns 402 explicitly on out-of-credits (nice). storage_path is unique per user (STORAGE_APP_NAME/uploads/{user_id}/{fid}{ext}) — good multitenancy.

server.py:864-877 update_project — A2 uses body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so partial PUT never wipes vat_tryb/termin_platnosci_*/dni_tyg. Confirmed live: PUT with only {nazwa} preserved all other fields. Good.

server.py:749-763 admin_reset_password — generates 16-char pw from _PW_ALPHABET, sets must_change_password=True, returns {reset,nowe}. Confirmed live: login with returned pw yields user.must_change_password=True.
server.py:1664 register_push — overwrites payload['user_id'] with authenticated user['id'] (E1b): a caller can't register a token for someone else. Good.

rca_of_issue: B5 LOGIN LOCKOUT NOT IMPLEMENTED. RCA: the RUNDA 1.3 diff description in problem_statement claims 'login lockout + register rate-limit (B5)' but only the REGISTER half landed. Grep of server.py shows the term 'lockout' appears only in seed-admin recovery comments (line 2166) and never in the /auth/login handler. Reproduction: (1) create/approve a throwaway TEST_ user with a known password, (2) POST /api/auth/login with wrong password 5-6 times, (3) observe all responses return 401 (never 423). Expected per spec: after 5 failed attempts return 423 with 15-min lock message. Mitigation: implement failed-attempt counter (users.failed_login_attempts + users.locked_until), check locked_until > now at start of login handler, increment counter on verify_pw False, reset on success, and set locked_until = now+15min at attempt 5. Guard: skip counting the seed admin OR provide an admin-unlock endpoint so the owner is never permanently locked. Retest with test_login_lockout_after_5_failed_attempts.
